Container.Name: DocuWaves
Container.Overview: Self-hosted documentation with a browser editor. Every page is a Markdown file in a Git repository you own; the database is only an index. Several projects, versions, languages, search, approval before publishing, and an MCP endpoint for AI assistants.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: DocuWaves listens on 8000 inside the container.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Content repository, index and session secret. Without a Git remote this is the only copy of your documentation: back it up.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address readers use, e.g. https://docs.example.com. Leave empty while trying it out.

Config.Name: Content repository URL
Config.Description: Optional: an empty Git repository to push the content to.

Config.Name: Content repository token
Config.Description: Access token for an https:// repository URL.
